comparison.objective: Place PCB support pins under a pick-and-place board while avoiding underside components.
comparison.physical_skill: Occlusion-aware pin positioning, insertion or placement, and collision avoidance beneath a board.
comparison.success_condition: Support pins correctly support the board and remain clear of underside parts; clearance and support thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: This tests support placement around sensitive geometry, not rotary damping adjustment, setscrew torque control, or dynamic stopping.
